INSERT INTO worksafe_inspections (citizen_id, reference, site, inspection_date, outcome)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
           ON CONFLICT (citizen_id, reference) DO UPDATE SET
              reference = EXCLUDED.reference, site = EXCLUDED.site, inspection_date = EXCLUDED.inspection_date, outcome = EXCLUDED.outcome
           RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted
